name: toxigen-refusal-bench-256-detoxmodel
description: This benchmark evaluates model refusal and detox behavior by presenting potentially toxic prompts and measuring whether a model refuses to produce toxic content. It is intended to test safety-aligned responses and robustness of detoxification mechanisms. The dataset contains examples and expected refusal/mitigation behavior for automated scoring.
reputation: A small, task-specific safety benchmark with limited community adoption, primarily used for targeted evaluation of detox models.
